The user wants to watch a Sci-Fi (scientific fiction) film in San Bruno at Century at Tanforan and XD.

We need to interpret their request:

They want to see a sci-fi movie at Century at Tanforan in San Bruno with an XD format? They say "and XD". That might mean they want it in XD format. So we should search for available sci-fi movies at that location and show type XD. Then maybe provide options or ask if they'd like to buy tickets.

But the system has no direct knowledge about current shows; but we can use the FindMovies function specifying location "San Bruno, CA"? But the tool expects location formatted as City, State. We have "Century at Tanforan" presumably in San Bruno, California. We'll call FindMovies with location "San Bruno, CA", theater_name "Century at Tanforan", genre "Science Fiction" - but note allowed values include "Sci-fi". Show_type "XD" isn't listed; only "regular","3d","imax". There's no "xd". Maybe it's a misinterpretation: XD could refer to "X-Dimension"? Actually some theaters offer "XD" as a premium format. Not sure if our tool supports that. It doesn't list XD. Might treat as "imax"? Or just ignore?

Given constraints, we can't specify XD because not supported. Could still proceed with "imax" perhaps. Alternatively we can mention limitation.
